text:
claire: Quick ticket  run a small pricing page usability test focused on tier naming + a simplified cost estimator. Keep it 10-14 days and measurable.

ben: What are the hypotheses?

claire: Hypotheses: 1) More product-aligned tier names reduce confusion for infra buyers. 2) A simple estimator that surfaces "estimated monthly spend" increases qualified leads (MQLs) and reduces support questions.

raj: Proposed tier names: "Launch / Scale / Isolated". Short bullets underneath each: SLA, data isolation, recommended workloads (e.g., prototypes, production apps, regulated).

sam: Can we run two variants: Variant A = copy + bullets only, Variant B = copy + bullets + new calculator? That isolates the impact of the calculator.

raj: Calculator payload for eng (minimal):
```
{
  "monthly_requests": 50000,
  "avg_tokens": 300,
  "cache_rate": 0.45,
  "private_option": false
}
```
Outputs: est monthly tokens, est hosted cost (USD), suggested tier. If private_option=true, show CTA to contact sales.

ben: Add a field to mark high-value: if est_monthly_cost > 30000 -> tag as "high_value_estimate" and ping sales-bot.

claire: Good. Events to track: calc_open, calc_submit, private_cta_click, mql_submit, faq_click. Also track "which-tier-picked" if user clicks a tier card.

sam: I'll set up the A/B in Optimizely and configure goals. I'll also add a success event for form submits with tag pricing-page-experiment-2.

legal-bot: Reminder: staged changes must be available for legal review 48h before launch. Please include the estimator wording and any rounding disclaimers.

raj: Implementation notes for eng PR: numbers localized, round estimates to nearest 5, show a small note: "Estimates are approximate; contact sales for exact pricing." Keep visuals minimal.

claire: Routing: form submissions get routed to inbound-sales with tag pricing-page-experiment-2. sales-bot: please prioritize high_value_estimate pings.

sales-bot: Will do. We'll triage and assign to AE pool.

ben: Timeline: stage Thu morning, internal QA Thu afternoon, legal ok by Fri, launch Mon 09:00 PT. Quick sync in one week to review early metrics.

claire: Thanks team 680 I'll drop the copy draft in this thread in 30m.
